entries.subject: Published numerical light-curve model
entries.finding: The published numerical light-curve model is used without re-fitting or invented terrain.

entries.subject: Rotationally resolved near-infrared spectroscopy as surface data
entries.finding: [Rotationally resolved near-infrared spectroscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.5962) is spatially unresolved, so it cannot provide registered surface texels.
entries.revisitWhen: Spatially registered surface measurements of Varuna are released.

entries.subject: JWST Varuna observing program
entries.finding: The [JWST Varuna observing-program overview](https://www.hou.usra.edu/meetings/acm2023/pdf/2534.pdf) identifies spectral and imaging observations, not a released global surface map. No texture is inferred from the program description.
entries.revisitWhen: The program's imaging is released with a usable surface map or resolved shape.
